game.title: Dark Souls: Remastered
game.blurb: Remaster of the 2011 dark fantasy action RPG set in Lordran, from FromSoftware and QLOC, released 2018-05-23. RAWG average playtime: 15 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Dark Souls: Remastered"; the guide is under "Dark Souls", at completion stage 0. It has written walkthrough subpages for only the first three areas (Northern Undead Asylum, about 7,400 characters; Firelink Shrine, about 4,000; Undead Burg, about 7,000) plus Achievements and trophies, Character and class, Controls, Table of Contents and short Bosses, Equipment, Gameplay, Shields and Weapons pages, so it is not a full guide and no structure was taken. darksouls.fandom.com answers the API ("Dark Souls: Remastered" redirects to "Dark Souls"), with about 22 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Youka" (an internal codename). None of the 41 Steam achievements are hidden. RAWG says the remaster includes the Artorias of the Abyss DLC, but no Steam achievement names it, so it has no chapter. The order of the Lord Souls chapter follows the schema list, not a route from any source; Gwyndolin and Priscilla were put with the covenants as optional bosses based on unlock rates (about 32 and 34 percent, below the Lord Souls at about 42).
